arguments.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about your front door. Sorry, our system first logged this as a fridge problem; we have corrected it to a door repair and treat it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please try not to slam the door, as the glass could break. If the door won't close and lock, please make sure it is secured as best you can, and keep children and pets away from it. If glass cracks, keep clear and tell us straight away. To arrange the repair, could you tell us: 1) Is it the door catch/latch, the hinges, or does the door drop or stick on the frame? 2) Is the door glass cracked or damaged now? 3) Can you still lock it? 4) Best times for access, any entry codes or alarms, and any pets? Photos would help. We are asking your landlord to approve the repair and will update you by 2024-06-07.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about your front door. Sorry, our system first logged this as a fridge problem; we have corrected it to a door repair and treat it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please try not to slam the door, as the glass could break. If the door won't close and lock, please make sure it is secured as best you can, and keep children and pets away from it. If glass cracks, keep clear and tell us straight away. To arrange the repair, could you tell us: 1) Is it the door catch/latch, the hinges, or does the door drop or stick on the frame? 2) Is the door glass cracked or damaged now? 3) Can you still lock it? 4) Best times for access, any entry codes or alarms, and any pets? Photos would help. We are asking your landlord to approve the repair and will update you by 2024-06-07.
